summary: Leader fell onto a ledge on Stettner's Ledges, Longs Peak; both climbers sustained fractures and soft-tissue injuries to feet; evacuated by rangers and helicopter.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park rangers, helicopter
notes: Victim William Esposito, 27, Boulder; 20-ft fall while leading on technical climb; report at 2:23 p.m.; patrol rangers reached him 4:53 p.m.; partner had lowered him 3 pitches; eight bystander climbers helped litter-carry him to helo LZ near Chasm Lake (11,760 ft); Flight for Life flew him to Boulder Community Hospital 6:37 p.m. County corrected to Boulder per Longs Peak convention. MERGED run 353: NPS morning-report account corroborates the rescue (rangers + 8 assisting climbers, litter carry to Chasm Lake LZ, Flight for Life to Boulder Community).
